jsonld.name: FAQ | Private AI Command Center and Audit | Bruce Works

acceptedAnswer.text: One private dashboard on a machine you own. Your files, notes, documents, tasks, content and AI agents live in one place instead of a stack of separate apps. I install it, build it to how you work, and train you on it.

mainEntity.name: Is it an app I download?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It’s done for you. I install it on your hardware, switch on the modules you use and move your work in. The code stays private; the machine, your files and your data are yours.

Sixteen modules ship today: Crew, Approvals, Jot, Office, Files, Library, Projects, School, Finance, Studio, Motion, Voice, Content studio, Notifications, Vault and Web. Each one is a switch, so you only see what you use.

mainEntity.name: What does it replace, and what doesn’t it?

acceptedAnswer.text: It stands in for the notes app, the office suite, the PDF signer, cloud storage, the to-do app, the project tracker, the invoicing app and the content calendar. It doesn’t replace the AI plan you pay for: your agents run on it. Posting stays in each social app; plans and drafts live here. And Notion-style Pages aren’t here yet: they’re coming.

mainEntity.name: Is this ChatGPT with a new skin?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. ChatGPT or another AI plan powers the agents, but the Command Center is where your files, tasks and approvals live, so the agents work with real context instead of whatever you paste into a chat.
Owner-led businesses first: the shop, the firm, the crew where the owner still runs the day. It also fits creators, students and families who want their files, plans and AI in one place.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be technical?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. I set it up, write it down in plain English and train you on your real work, not a demo.
A machine you own: a Mac mini, a mini PC or a server you already have. I can source a mini PC or Mac mini at cost and set it up. The audit checks whether a machine you already own is up to it.

On storage you own. Files, notes and history stay on your machine. When an agent works, it sends the AI provider you use what that job needs, the same as any AI chat. Local models are an option when the hardware and the job allow it.

mainEntity.name: Does Bruce Works host my agents or hold my data?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, not by default. Accounts, storage, subscriptions, credentials and hardware stay with you wherever practical. Any exception is scoped and approved in writing first.

mainEntity.name: Can I reach it away from home or the shop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you want to. It’s reachable from any device on your network, and from anywhere once secure remote access is set up.
Your AI agents live inside the Command Center, next to your documents, calendar and files, so they work with real context. Each one has its own job, its own briefing and its own approvals.

mainEntity.name: Can an agent do something I didn’t approve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anything risky waits for your OK. Agents ask before they send, delete or run anything that matters, and you approve or deny from the dashboard or your phone. The Vault hands an agent a key without it landing in a chat.

mainEntity.name: How many agents do I get?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foundation comes with one, Operator with up to three. Each extra agent is $450 and gets its own job, briefing and approvals.

Yes. Foundation starts with a stock theme like Field Manual or Harbor. Operator includes a custom theme built from your brand: your colors, type, corners and logo. On Foundation, a custom theme is a $650 add-on.

New features roll in without touching your look. With Command, I roll them in for you, run health checks, verify your backups and fix what breaks. Without Command, your system keeps running the way it was installed.
Pages: Notion-style pages and linked databases with tables, boards and calendars. It’s designed, not shipped yet. Until then, notes live in Jot and documents in Office.

The audit is $197 remote or $297 in person in San Diego. A Foundation install is $1,950 once, Operator is $4,950 once, and Command, the optional monthly care, is $295 a month. Your exact price is set in writing after the audit.
Only if you want Command. Foundation and Operator are paid once. Command is $295 a month after either one, and you can cancel anytime.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I stop Command?

acceptedAnswer.text: It keeps running on your machine, and it’s yours: your data and your files. What stops is the monthly care: new features rolled in, the health checks and the monthly workflow. If you want to take it from there yourself, that’s fine by me. Small edits are easy now, and depending on your package I’ll walk you through it and teach you how.
Yes. Book a build within 30 days of your audit and the $197 (or $297) comes off the price.
Your AI plan (your agents run on it), the hardware (sourced at cost if you want me to), and travel or extra scope, which are quoted up front before any work starts.

Yes. Extra agents, a custom theme, workflow buildouts and the move-in from your old apps are add-ons you can book after the install. Moving from Foundation to Operator later is quoted against what’s already built.

With the AI Leverage Audit. It maps how you work, ranks the top opportunities by time saved, sets what data stays private, and ends with a 30-day plan and a clear call: build, optimize, or do nothing.
Either. Remote is $197 and works from anywhere. In person in San Diego is $297. You get the same written plan.

mainEntity.name: How long does the audit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The target is 7 business days from the day your intake and source material are complete.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to send private files or passwords?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The request form needs none of that. During intake we agree on what I should look at and how; passwords and private records never go through a web form.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to buy a build after the audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The plan is written so you can run it without me. If you do build within 30 days, the audit fee is credited.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with agencies and prime contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Bruce Works is an SDVOSB and VOSB (SBA VetCert), a California DVBE and Small Business (Micro), and active in SAM.gov for all awards. I support agencies and primes with document and data operations, workflow modernization and private AI systems.
From the actual scope: labor, risk, volume, controls, reporting, travel, schedule and acceptance requirements. A low-cost commercial pilot doesn’t set the price of a government or enterprise scope.
